caseDetails: 40 mm · 18 ct Everose gold · solid screw-down case back
functions: No date. Small seconds at 6; 30-minute counter at 3; 12-hour counter at 9; centre chronograph seconds; stop seconds.
source: Rolex official 126505 specifications and Rolex Daytona technical newsroom; researched 8 October 2026
confidence: Manufacturer-backed base-reference specification; dial execution must be checked separately
lookupScope: Exact base reference; images illustrate labelled dial variants rather than all configurations
notes: Everose-gold fixed tachymeter bezel, not ceramic. Gold Oyster bracelet, Oysterlock safety clasp and Easylink 5 mm extension. Triplock crown and screw-down pushers. Sapphire crystal. Rated 100 m when new; not evidence of present water resistance. Do not assign a production year from a random serial or modern clasp code. Compare actual 4131 architecture and finishing, not engraving alone. A different calibre requires review. Dial colour/diamond setting cannot be determined from 126505 alone.

technicalDetail.movement: Column wheel and vertical clutch; nickel-phosphorus Chronergy escapement; blue Parachrom hairspring; Paraflex shock protection; variable-inertia balance with Microstella regulation and full traversing balance bridge.
technicalDetail.finishing: Rolex Côtes de Genève bridges and cut-out rotor. Compare layout, balance and finishing against the pictured 4131. The yellow-gold rotor described for platinum Daytonas must not be treated as the Everose 126505 expectation.
technicalDetail.accuracy: Manufacturer specification −2/+2 seconds/day after casing; a rate result alone does not authenticate a watch.
technicalDetail.bracelet: Three-piece solid Everose-gold links; manufacturer describes ceramic inserts around precious-metal bracelet link pins. No verified bracelet-number, clasp-code/date or weight threshold assigned.
technicalDetail.safety: No special gas/fluid-filled construction identified in manufacturer specifications. Apply normal bench procedure; no automatic clearance to open.
